# Windoc

> Canvas-based document editor for the web

Windoc is an open-source document editor that renders using HTML5 Canvas instead of the DOM. It provides pixel-perfect pagination, rich text formatting, tables, images, watermarks, headers, footers, and native print support. Unlike DOM-based editors (ProseMirror, Tiptap, Quill), Windoc renders on Canvas for true page fidelity.

## Packages

- `@windoc/core` — Framework-agnostic canvas editor engine. Instantiate directly with `new Editor(container, data, options)`.
- `@windoc/react` — React bindings. Drop-in `<Editor />` component with composable toolbar and footer tools.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/): What Windoc is and why it exists
- [Getting Started](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/getting-started): Installation and quick start guide
- [API: @windoc/core](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/api/core): Constructor, EditorData, EditorOptions, commands, listeners, shortcuts, context menus
- [API: @windoc/react](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/api/react): Editor component props, composable tools, useEditor hook, useFooter hook
- [API: Editor Options](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/api/editor-options): Full EditorOptions reference
- [API: Commands](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/api/commands): Full command API reference
- [Guide: Custom Toolbar](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/guides/custom-toolbar): Build a custom toolbar using composable tool components
- [Guide: Custom Footer](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/guides/custom-footer): Build a custom footer/statusbar
- [Guide: Keyboard Shortcuts](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/guides/keyboard-shortcuts): Register custom keyboard shortcuts
- [Guide: Drag and Drop](https://aliansyahfirdaus.github.io/windoc/docs/guides/drag-and-drop): Handle drag-and-drop in the editor

## Quick Example

```tsx
import { Editor } from '@windoc/react'
import '@windoc/core/style.css'
import '@windoc/react/style.css'

function App() {
  return (
    <Editor
      defaultValue={{ main: [{ value: 'Hello, Windoc!' }] }}
      options={{ margins: [40, 40, 40, 40] }}
      onReady={(editor) => console.log(editor)}
      onChange={(data) => console.log(data)}
    />
  )
}
```
